C08-M03-L05-F1.title: Designing a dashboard panel from a question
C08-M03-L05-F1.caption: Each panel starts from a question with an audience and an action, and only then gets a query, a threshold, a visual form, a drilldown and an owner.
C08-M03-L05-F1.alt: Top-to-bottom flow of seven steps: Question (is a critical source silent for more than 30 minutes?); Audience and action (who reads it, what they do); Data and query (sources, fields, time range, refresh); Baseline and threshold (what is normal, when the state changes); Visual form (number, line, table or top-N); Context and drilldown (underlying events, runbook link); Owner and review (retire if nobody acts). A feedback arrow returns from the last step to the first, labelled review: rewrite, merge or retire panels nobody acts on.

C08-M03-L05-F1.note: If no audience and action can be named, do not build the panel; if the threshold is precise, make it an alert too.
